Subject: Principles of Wealth
Core_Directive: Publish independent educational analysis of wealth-creation frameworks. Frame every video as curation and analysis, never as impersonation of Ray Dalio or Bridgewater Associates.

Philosophical_Core.Core_Belief: Wealth follows structure, not intensity. Principles compound; impulse does not.
Philosophical_Core.The_Conflict: Contrast professional decision-making under uncertainty against hustle-culture income myths, ego-driven investing, and the confusion of net worth with cash-flow health.
Science_Metaphors: The economy as a machine: credit, productivity, and psychology as moving parts
Pain as data: feedback loops that refine strategy instead of punishing the operator
Compounding as a law: structure over time beats talent in a single year
Risk versus ruin: surviving drawdowns is the real edge
Diversification as engineering: uncorrelated parts, not a pile of similar bets

Narrative_Angles.description: Name the economic principle, then show how professionals actually apply it.
Treat personal finance as a designed system: cash flow, leverage, debt, and scaling.
Ego, cycles, drawdowns, and humility — the inner tax on investment returns.

Batch_Research.Rotation_Pattern: Rotate FRAMEWORK, MACHINE, PSYCHOLOGY. Open with the principle, then the mechanism.
